alex_cust: Hi — trying to redeem a promo via the API but it returns promo.invalid_or_expired. Same code redeems fine in the dashboard. Account: ac-998, region: eu-west-1. Error payload:

curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem?code=SUMMER-DRIFT' \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'

Response: {\"error\":\"promo.invalid_or_expired\", \"detail\":\"code not found\"}

Has anyone seen a case where the same code works in UI but API says invalid? Repro is trivial for us, can provide logs (will redact tokens).

maria_support: Thanks — sorry about that. A few quick questions: did you pass the code in the query string like above or in the JSON body? Also can you confirm whether your client library does any URL encoding (axios/fetch)? If you can paste the exact client snippet (redact auth) that helps.

alex_cust: Thanks — we pass it in the query param. Using fetch in a serverless function: 

const code = 'SUMMER-DRIFT'
await fetch(`https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem?code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })

We use encodeURIComponent out of habit. In the dashboard I pasted SUMMER-DRIFT and it worked.

maria_support: That is helpful. Please hang on, tagging ops to check incoming raw requests to promo-service.

kevin_ops: I pulled the raw access logs for ac-998 around the time of the request. The promo-service received the code value as "SUMMER%252DDRIFT". Looks like it was double-encoded (\"-%22 -> %2D, then % -> %25 -> %252D). Our redemption table stores canonical codes as plain ASCII like "SUMMER-DRIFT" so exact match fails and we return promo.invalid_or_expired.

kevin_ops: Quick root cause: our HTTP gateway automatically URL-encodes query params in some client flows, and client also encoded with encodeURIComponent. Promo-service previously assumed a single encoding pass and performed one decode, so double-encoded strings slip through. We should either robustly decode or validate and return a clearer error.

maria_support: OK — immediate mitigation: please call the endpoint with JSON body instead: 

POST /v1/promos/redeem
Content-Type: application/json
{ "code": "SUMMER-DRIFT" }

That avoids gateway double-encoding. I can also apply a manual credit while we patch. Do you want a one-time grant so affected users aren't blocked?

alex_cust: Yes please, a manual grant would be great. There are ~12 customers who hit this in the last hour.

kevin_ops: Noted. I filed an internal bug (infra#5421) to normalize promo inputs and to return a 400 with a clear message when encoded characters are present. Also adding a small fix to decode twice for now to unblock traffic. Patch scheduled to next deploy window.

deploybot: Deploy queued: stage infra/promos/normalize-inputs v1.2.3 -> staging at 2024-01-05T10:15:00Z, prod planned after validation.

maria_support: Manual credits applied: 12 accounts credited 10 USD promo credit each under internal case CC-2024-1543. I also sent an email to the affected account owners with instructions to call via JSON body if they integrate directly.

alex_cust: Thanks all — confirmed one of the affected users used the JSON body after you suggested and it worked. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

kevin_ops: Follow-up actions: (1) healthcheck to detect encoded query params and alert, (2) unit tests for gateway vs client encoding, (3) prod patch to normalize. Will update infra#5421 with ETA after staging verification.

maria_support: Closing thread unless alex wants to keep it open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

alex_cust: OK to close, thanks! :pray:
